Creates a PDF report of one or several AudioMoth recorders

Source: R/report.R
create_report.Rd

Prepares a Quarto folder with everything it needs (report.qmd, _section.qmd, report_functions.R, report_data.rds and the spectrograms of the examples) and renders it as a PDF with Quarto and Typst (LaTeX is not needed).

Usage

create_report(
  recorders,
  by_recorder = TRUE,
  output = NULL,
  title = "Acoustic monitoring report",
  min_confidence = 0.5,
  map = TRUE,
  open = interactive(),
  overwrite_template = FALSE
)

Arguments

recorders

An audiomoth object analysed with analyze_birdnet() or a list of them (several recorders).

by_recorder

With several recorders, TRUE gives each recorder its own section and FALSE combines them into a single analysis.

output

Folder of the report. By default, report/ inside the results folder of the recorder; with several recorders it must be given.

title

Title of the report.

min_confidence

Only the detections with at least this confidence are summarised.

map

Include the map of the recorders.

open

Open the PDF at the end.

overwrite_template

Copy the template files again, replacing the edited ones.

Value

Invisibly, the path of the PDF file.

Details

The report includes:

  • a summary of the sampling and the results;

  • a map of the recorders (on OpenStreetMap when maptiles, sf and terra are installed and there is an Internet connection; otherwise without background) and a table with their configuration;

  • the state of the recordings: recordings per day, problems, recordings that BirdNET could not analyse, battery and temperature;

  • the detected species, with their confidence and their activity by day and by hour and, with several recorders, which recorder detected each;

  • the spectrograms of the examples created with extract_examples();

  • the records exported with export_observation() and the result of the validation by ear (create_validation());

  • the parameters of the analysis and the versions of the software.

The template files are copied only the first time: later calls keep the edits made to them (unless overwrite_template = TRUE) and only update the data.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # interactive()
# Needs Quarto (included in RStudio and Positron): see check_requirements()
card <- system.file("extdata", "example", "card", package = "AudiomothR")
am <- read_audiomoth(card, coordinates = "41.00, -3.00", output = tempfile())
am$detections <- read_detections(system.file("extdata", "example",
  "birdnet_detections.csv", package = "AudiomothR"))
pdf <- create_report(am)                                  # one recorder

# Several recorders together:
# create_report(list(am1, am2, am3), by_recorder = FALSE, output = "report_river")
}
